verdict.rationale: Gumroad documents a public REST API, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and so did api.md. The MCP integration and the human-readable API docs are adjacent features, not a downloadable spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
